notes.title: WORKS IN PROGRESS & UPDATES
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44478278/00b817de6f09cc7a142721d89e39211c3a42631b.png[/img]

Thank you everyone in the community for playing our 2nd demo and giving us feedbacks.
We have read pretty much every feedbacks, they are invaluable to us, and we're committed to continuously improving the game based on your input. 
Below is a list of our key focus points of ỉmpovements for the next version of the game (Alpha test - full game):

[list]
[*] Improving player movement 
[*] Enhancing animation, adding more animation for all characters & NPCs
[*] Optimizing performance & Improving FPS
[*] Gameplay balancing
[*] New map content
[/list]

[b]Tentative schedule:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Alpha test: October 2024 (Steam Next Fest)
[*] Early access: Jan 2025 (Before Tet)
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this journey as we strive to create the best possible gaming experience for our community. Stay tuned for more updates as we work towards delivering an even more polished and enjoyable gaming experience.

Young Buffalo Team

notes.title: 2024 NEW MAP UPDATE
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the major update for Demo Version 2.0 of Vệ Thần, now officially available on Steam. We eagerly await everyone's experience with this demo.

After receiving numerous reviews and feedback from the previous demo version, the Vệ Thần development team is pleased to introduce notable improvements that have been made in this game update:

[list]
[*] Movement Improvements
[*] Camera Improvements
[*] Expanded Map Area
[*] New Storyline Development, NPCs, Landmarks, Interactions, Dialogue: Added to the game.
[*] Balancing Healing Spells and Stats
[*] Lighting & UI fix
[*] Soundtrack, Sound Effects & Background Music: Improved in Demo 2.0, with many new sound effects added and more refined VFX.
[*] Bug Fixes: The team has fixed most of the bugs from the previous demo
[/list]

notes.title: First Update (demo v0.326)
notes.content:
Thank you for giving us your honest feedbacks for the demo, we took them seriously and has been working on the game everyday to improve the game.

This update includes (version 0.326)

- New VFX
- New Sound
- Improved control & attack movements

There will major update, another free demo is on the way in December, with new content (bosses, mobs, weapons)

Please help us & continue sharing your feedbacks so we could finish building this game together.

Cảm ơn mọi người đã đóng góp ý kiến để tụi mình có thể hoàn thiện game.
